description: This file contains methods related to managing file accessibility within the Mattermost application, including filtering files based on cloud plan limits, marking files as inaccessible, and handling inaccessible files.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main application struct with methods to handle file accessibility filtering.

methods.name: removeInaccessibleContentFromFilesSlice
methods.description: Removes content from files beyond the cloud plan's limit and returns the first inaccessible file time.

methods.name: filterInaccessibleFiles
methods.description: Filters out files that are past the cloud plan's limit, modifying the file list accordingly.

methods.name: isInaccessibleFile
methods.description: Checks if a specific file is past the cloud plan's limit and returns the first inaccessible file time.

methods.name: getFilteredAccessibleFiles
methods.description: Returns accessible files filtered according to cloud plan limits and indicates if any files are inaccessible.
